instructions: Cook spaghetti per package; steam broccoli in the last 3 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, garlic, ginger, and 3 tbsp hot pasta water into a sauce.
Toss noodles and broccoli in the sauce.
Serve with Organic electrolyte drink (355 g).
